i802.title: Reconcile production Goal completion with planner state evaluation
i802.body:
<!-- issue736-runtime:goal-contract:v1 -->
The approved #736 test consolidation reproduces production Goal contract failures using complete real Characters, real Conditions, and the actual GraphManager. Runtime files remain unchanged from main `11b6e935`.

## Evidence

- `Goal(..., completion_conditions={False: [Condition(...)]}, ...)` constructs, but `Goal.check_completion()` calls `.check_condition()` on the list.
- `GOAPPlanner._goal_satisfied(goal, state)` calls `goal.check_completion(state)` although the full Goal method accepts no state argument; it catches the mismatch and reports False.
- Strict already-satisfied/reachable/cost-selection cases return None. Negative unreachable/blocked cases do return None, but a positive completion control fails; that is not evidence that the negative no-plan path itself is broken.
- Plan evaluation and real-Goal feasibility failures are retained separately, so constructor/signature errors cannot be counted as successful bug detection.

Directly rerunnable sources are under `docs/planning/issue-736/execution/blocked/planner_*.py.txt`; #736's consolidation PR will retain the exact commands, 20/25-second captures and validation report. Neither test doubles nor an import-forced lightweight Goal establishes this full-domain contract.

i803.title: Restore required motive-satisfaction contribution using real PersonalMotives
i803.body:
<!-- issue736-runtime:motive-contribution:v1 -->
The approved #736 consolidation uses a complete real basic-memory Character and fixed non-saturated inputs. Changing hunger/shelter/stability/social_wellbeing motive scores together from 2 to 8 leaves `calculate_happiness()` unchanged at `0.3610225808639045`.

`calculate_happiness()` calls get_food_motive/get_safety_motive/get_social_motive, which are absent on real PersonalMotives; its bare exception handler suppresses the contribution. Actual API names include hunger, stability and social_wellbeing. Separate supported motive caps and social/romantic/family cases pass; those passes do not satisfy this missing contribution.

Reproduction: `PYTHONPATH=. python docs/planning/issue-736/execution/blocked/happiness-motive-satisfaction.py.txt` from the repository root using the locked core interpreter. It retains the standard 20-second diagnostic / 25-second parent deadline, fails as a requirement, and is deliberately outside ordinary test discovery. #736's consolidation PR will retain its original child source, output, timestamp and hashes. The existing root happiness scan remains intact pending a reviewed blocker disposition.

## Scoped acceptance for later implementation

- Review which actual PersonalMotives represent the required basic motive-satisfaction contribution; do not add fake getters just to satisfy a test fixture.
- Prove scores 2 versus 8 change the expected contribution with other Character inputs fixed, using real Motive/PersonalMotives/Character objects.
- Keep legitimate empty/no-partner/no-family behavior and existing supported motive/social/romantic/family contributions working.
- Make invalid required motive evaluation visible rather than silently successful; retain original failed evidence and test the chosen error policy.

Related: #736, #139 and #391. Proposed scheduling is after separate human gate #738 within Character completion work; precise implementation order/design awaits review. This records a required gap and approves no runtime repair, phase gate, weakened #391 acceptance or #736 closure.
